categories.name: أَسْمَاءُ الْمَكَانِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Nouns of Place (Ism Makan) in the Quran

items.verse: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
items.verseEn: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

items.verse: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًۭا
items.verseEn: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.

items.verse: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًۭا
items.verseEn: And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.

items.verse: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًۭا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۖ قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُۥ قَلِيلًۭا ثُمَّ أَضْطَرُّهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
items.verseEn: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day." [Allāh] said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."

categories.name: أَفْعَالُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فِي سُورَةِ الطُّورِ
categories.nameEn: Verbs of the people of Paradise in Surah At-Tur

items.en: They will pass to one another
items.verse: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

items.verse: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
items.verseEn: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

items.verse: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.verseEn: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
No! You are going to know.
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الرُّؤْيَةِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ
categories.nameEn: Quranic Terms for Seeing and Witnessing

items.verseEn: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

items.verse: وَٱلَّـٰتِى يَأْتِينَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ فَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةًۭ مِّنكُمْ ۖ فَإِن شَهِدُوا۟ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِى ٱلْبُيُوتِ حَتَّىٰ يَتَوَفَّىٰهُنَّ ٱلْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًۭا
items.verseEn: Those who commit immorality [i.e., unlawful sexual intercourse] of your women - bring against them four [witnesses] from among you. And if they testify, confine them [i.e., the guilty women] to houses until death takes them or Allāh ordains for them [another] way.
So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

harf.hint: A place of settlement; often described as 'the secure' in an oath

deduction.title: The Voice from the Outskirts
deduction.intro: You stand in a city where three messengers have come with clear signs, but the people mock them and cling to their old ways. From the farthest part of the city, a figure sprints toward the crowd, breathless and determined, to speak truth in the face of rejection. Who is this soul who risked everything for a message not their own?
clues: I lived among a people who had received messengers with clear signs, yet they turned away in arrogance.
I came running from the farthest part of the city when I heard of the messengers' call.
I said to my people, 'O my people, follow the messengers. Follow those who ask no reward of you, for they are rightly guided.'
I was not a prophet, but I believed in the messengers and urged my people to do the same.
My people mocked my advice and accused me of being an extremist.
When they killed me, Allah told me to enter Paradise, and I wished my people could know the forgiveness and honor I received.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The man from the farthest part of the city (Ya-Sin)
One of the three messengers sent to the city
A prominent merchant of the city
A ruler of the city
The leader of the disbelievers
identity.answer: The man from the farthest part of the city (Ya-Sin)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Preaching to his people to follow the messengers
Building a ship to save believers from a flood
Being thrown into a fire for faith
Being swallowed by a whale
Being given a kingdom and wisdom
trial.answer: Preaching to his people to follow the messengers

location.label: Key Element
options: The farthest part of the city
The ark
The well
The burning bush
The cave
location.answer: The farthest part of the city

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Entered Paradise and wished his people could know his forgiveness
Drowned with his people for rejecting the message
Was given a miracle of the she-camel
Became a ruler after his trial
Was saved by Allah and remained with his people
outcome.answer: Entered Paradise and wished his people could know his forgiveness

deduction.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
deduction.verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)

translations: Only the believers (are) those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and when they are
with him for a matter (of) collective action not they go until they (have) asked his permission
Indeed those who ask your permission those [those who] believe in Allah and His Messenger
So when they ask your permission for some affair of theirs then give permission to whom you will among them
and ask forgiveness for them (of) Allah Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
scramble.hint: A foundational verse on the brotherhood of believers and the duty to make peace between disputing Muslims, ending with an encouragement to attain Allah's mercy through taqwa (God-consciousness).
scramble.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ جَامِعٍۢ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
words: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟
مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ جَامِعٍۢ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ
فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ
وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
scramble.verseEn: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
